verified_claims.claim: Paper is Liu et al., IEEE TPWRS 38(4), 2023; 2019 is the example input year. Authors' released benchmark is 57 buses and 94 AC branches, not the derived 140-bus counterpart.
The construction retains all 140 original bus identities; 191 = 140 + 51 station-detail additions; 148 = 140 + eight retained 345-kV ports; 43 other station terminals are reduced and recovered.

Current detailed AC state is 266 buses before Dover and 267 afterward; 75 numerical section buses and one post-Dover regulated port are not additional substations. Current solve retains 148 bus voltages and recovers detailed voltages/currents.

Rainey-Corona is present throughout 2025 after its May 2023 completion; Gowanus-Greenwood and Goethals-Fox Hills activate at next-midnight May21 and May30 policies; Dover full service is Dec19 HB23 EST; F84 energized July28,2019.
Nine predecessor downstate aggregate rows are inactive under registered replacements; most Long Island additions expose historical detail rather than newly constructed 2025 substations.

The current model uses coupled AC equations, explicit loss allocation, and complex-admittance recovery; parent41 parameter consistency and section-local parent185/195 compensation are declared synthetic repairs.

Current generator axis is 1466 = 1437 native + 27 regional loss participants + HQ + PV20; six transfer records are four inherited representations plus two Ontario PAR substitutions, not six physical HVDC assets.
